calls.reason: The only evidence is Salesforce's hiring freeze, which it credits to productivity gains, and SWE-Lancer task failures. Neither shows replacement or its absence, or proves the causal 'because it can't'.

Reuters reports Replit's revenue jumped to $150M and its valuation rose to $3B. Cognition was valued at $10.2B and Cursor at $10B, and Gamma was profitable. Leading startups weren't 'struggling to stay alive', though TechCrunch confirms some negative margins.
No realized cost records confirm the $50bn-per-GW premise. Huang's March 2026 shift to a $30bn investment changes the deal but doesn't test the conditional arithmetic.

Apple's puzzle study shows accuracy collapsing as complexity rises. But the tool-use and replication papers qualify that finding, and none measures practical agent reliability, so 'fatal blow' is unsettled.
The claim has no deadline, and no evidence links media coverage to losses. Fidelity reports record 401(k) balances in Q2 2026, and the Chinese retail losses don't address US 401(k)s.
CNBC sources report $8B burned in 2025, so that part held. The hedged near-$1 trillion-by-2030 part can't be judged until 2030.
